files.README.md:
# jquery-zombie-countdown bower install jquery-zombie-countdown ```html
``` Run `grunt` to lint, test (PhantomJS) and minify.

vitals.name: jquery-zombie-countdown
vitals.description: A jQuery plugin that counts down to Halloween. Grunt + Bower, 2014.

deps.name: bower
deps.cause: Bower itself recommends migrating to npm/yarn.

deps.name: grunt
deps.cause: Grunt task runner is effectively unmaintained; npm scripts replace it.

deps.name: grunt-contrib-uglify
deps.cause: UglifyJS cannot parse modern syntax; esbuild minifies faster.

deps.name: jquery
deps.cause: From bower.json. jQuery 1.x → 4.x: $.browser, .live and .size removed; .bind/.delegate deprecated; $.trim/$.isArray/$.parseJSON gone in 4.0.

deps.name: grunt-contrib-jshint
deps.cause: Grunt + JSHint pipeline superseded by ESLint.

configs.title: Travis CI config
configs.cause: travis-ci.org shut down in 2021; targets Node 0.10. CI has been silently dead.
configs.remedy: Replace with a GitHub Actions workflow on Node 20/22.

configs.title: Bower package manifest
configs.cause: Bower is deprecated and its registry is read-only; front-end deps must come from npm.

configs.title: Grunt build pipeline
configs.cause: Grunt 0.4 plugins are unmaintained; grunt-contrib-qunit pulls PhantomJS which no longer installs.
configs.remedy: jshint → `npm run lint` (ESLint); uglify → `npm run build` (esbuild); qunit (PhantomJS) → generated node:test suite

configs.title: JSHint config
configs.cause: JSHint does not understand modern syntax and is superseded by ESLint.
configs.remedy: Translate options and globals into an ESLint 9 flat config.

configs.title: No lockfile
configs.cause: Installs are not reproducible; the dependency tree drifts on every install.
configs.remedy: Commit the package-lock.json generated by the first `npm install`.

configs.title: No license
configs.cause: Nobody can legally reuse the resurrected code.

plan.title: Exhume config fossils
items: Travis CI config: Replace with a GitHub Actions workflow on Node 20/22.
Bower package manifest: Move jquery into package.json.
Grunt build pipeline: jshint → `npm run lint` (ESLint); uglify → `npm run build` (esbuild); qunit (PhantomJS) → generated node:test suite
JSHint config: Translate options and globals into an ESLint 9 flat config.

plan.title: Transplant dependencies
items: jquery@~1.11.0 → jquery@^4.1.0 — Breaking changes patched by 5 codemods.

patches.before:
language: node_js
node_js:
  - "0.10"
before_script:
  - npm install -g grunt-cli bower
  - bower install

patches.after:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test
